assessments.status: bounded corroboration of an existing attributed assessment; no new finding count
assessments.first_contract: On the generated opaque apply branch, a matching remote type is downcast and cloned into the wrapper, and the local branch clones a matching Self; a mismatch returns ApplyError. Generated common as_any_mut returns &mut self.0 for a remote wrapper, while set delegates the boxed value to Reflect::take and then assigns the resulting whole self. The source does not itself establish Reflect::take’s uninspected implementation, actual invocation, or validity of a value that was already invalid.
assessments.project_connection: 95e adapters declare reflect_remote(AnimationElapsed) and reflect_remote(UnitInterval), both opaque; the remote generator emits a transparent wrapper containing the named Remote and exposes references to that Remote. Current owner types keep f32 backing private. AnimationElapsed::from_seconds checks finite/nonnegative, accepting zero, and UnitInterval::from_fraction checks finite and [0,1], accepting endpoints. Both owners declare Serde try_from=f32 and their TryFrom source delegates to those constructors. These declarations are not executed macro output and do not establish every owner operation or alternate ingress safe.
assessments.consumer: Current DirectControlState derives Reflect and declares UnitInterval progress and AnimationElapsed mouse timers with the corresponding remote adapters. SprintInputState declares another elapsed adapter. These are typed field annotations, not proof that a supported caller mutates or deserializes them through reflection, that feature configuration activates those paths, or that individually valid replacements maintain cross-field relationships.
assessments.conditions: Applies only if the relevant reflect_remote/opaque branches and features are actually selected and generated. Wrapper layout assertions, unsafe conversion internals, trait take/downcast semantics, semantic validity of pre-existing typed values, aggregates and unrelated owners are not fully audited. No supported failure or execution witness is established.
assessments.future_repair_direction: First establish actual enabled build/feature and a real reflection, construction or deserialization ingress, with its owner and aggregate policy; preserve checked scalar owners, zero-valid elapsed, endpoint-valid fractions and intended whole-value operations.

Does an authorized reflective caller invoke apply, set, mutable Any or reflected Deserialize on these fields; through which source ingress and at what authority boundary?
What are the precise semantics of Reflect::take and dynamic deserialization for the actual package and caller? They are outside this fresh read; earlier witness claims keep its own author and range.

thirteen_bounded_perspectives.producer-propagation: Adapters declare checked project types at reflective fields; actual producers and consumers are unproved.
thirteen_bounded_perspectives.existing-type-owners: The remote target is the existing AnimationElapsed or UnitInterval owner, not an independently admitted raw float.
thirteen_bounded_perspectives.admission-contracts: Checked constructor and TryFrom source supply a narrow safeguard; all active ingress routes are not exhausted.
thirteen_bounded_perspectives.invariant-operations: Opaque apply is typed whole-value clone; mutable typed access and set delegate to owner methods and framework take.
thirteen_bounded_perspectives.aggregate-states: Individual scalar validity does not prove DirectControlState cross-field coherence.
thirteen_bounded_perspectives.type-ownership: Native wrapper adapts canonical project owners; feature-controlled generated code is not their semantic validator.
thirteen_bounded_perspectives.redundant-authority: A wrapper over one typed remote is source-shown; no all-system single-authority conclusion follows.
thirteen_bounded_perspectives.behavior-preservation: Finite elapsed permits zero and UnitInterval includes endpoints; keep these distinct from positive-only lengths.
thirteen_bounded_perspectives.enum-shapes: No unsupported enum-shape conclusion from this helper scope.
thirteen_bounded_perspectives.derivability: Requested derive and explicit checked TryFrom serve different roles; no blanket derive simplification is justified.
thirteen_bounded_perspectives.type-granularity: Seconds and fractions have distinct meanings and bounds even when both use f32 backing.
thirteen_bounded_perspectives.magic-strings: Feature/env names and framework diagnostics are native interface vocabulary, not proof of an application string-classifier defect.
thirteen_bounded_perspectives.magic-numbers: Zero and one are bounds of admitted elapsed/fraction domains; not evidence of a standalone numeric-literal defect.
